author: ETA PRIME
description:
Can an Android phone actually run AAA PC games? Today we’re pushing the Red Magic 11 Pro and the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 to the absolute limit by emulating Cyberpunk 2077 natively using Game Hub.
[The Hook] This isn't cloud gaming. This isn't moonlight streaming from a local rig. We are running the full x86 PC version of Cyberpunk 2077 directly on an ARM chipset. I’ve tried to get this game running on mobile devices for years with no luck—until now.
